editorial:
Imagine a world where an Empress loses her royal jewels in the mountains while running for her life. Fast forward ten years, and a simple villager stumbles upon this massive treasure. You might think that is where the story ends, but that is actually where the real fun begins. Once the word gets out that someone has found the royal gold, every greedy bandit in the area heads for the village. However, they are in for a huge surprise because they have to get through Tigress first. She is the villager's daughter and an absolute powerhouse when it comes to martial arts. You will love watching her take on these thugs with her incredible fighting skills.

The action is the best part of the whole experience, and the fight scenes are choreographed with a lot of energy. You will notice that the pacing stays quick, so you never feel bored while waiting for the next big clash. While some of the dialogue feels a bit dated, the sheer excitement of the combat makes up for it. If you enjoy old-school kung fu movies, you should definitely check this out. It is best to grab the 4K Blu-ray for your physical collection to see the detail, but renting it on Apple TV is a great way to see if you like it first.
endingExplained: In the final showdown, Tigress uses her amazing skills to fight off the remaining bandits who are desperate for the gold. She manages to defeat the lead villain in a big battle, proving she is the strongest person in the village. After the fighting stops, the greed of the bandits is punished, and the peace is restored to the town. The treasure is secured, and Tigress is recognized as a true hero.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves classic kung fu fights and strong female leads.
